comment: Every configurable parameter in one file. The mass is drawn once per run from a weighted list (the transport knows a single mass, so sampleOnce is mandatory for anything but a fixed value); a seed-dependent drawn-once value cannot be known before the run, so prefer a fixed mass for production and derive the transport keys with MonopolesTransportKeys(). The energy range has to be compatible with every mass the list can give: etot >= mass*cosh(y) must have a solution, otherwise the generator stops.
